name: vscode-ifc
description: Professional VS Code support for IFC STEP files powered by the IFC Language Server.

commands.title: IFC Language Support: Download Language Server
IFC Language Support: Restart Language Server
IFC Language Support: Show Resolved Language Server

ifc.server.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a custom IFC language server binary.

ifc.server.args.markdownDescription: Additional command-line arguments passed to the IFC language server.

ifc.server.versionOverride.markdownDescription: Advanced: use a specific IFC language server Git tag instead of the version pinned by the extension, for example `v0.3.0`.

ifc.server.githubRepository.markdownDescription: GitHub repository used for IFC language server downloads, in owner/repo form.

ifc.server.downloadAssetPattern.markdownDescription: Optional substring used to narrow the selected GitHub release asset.

ifc.schema.overwriteExpSchemaWithLocal.markdownDescription: Optional absolute path to a local `.exp` schema file. If set, the language server uses this schema for diagnostics and hover regardless of the IFC file's declared `FILE_SCHEMA(...)`.

ifc.schema.addLocalSchemaToSelection.markdownDescription: Optional list of local `.exp` files or directories containing `.exp` files. These paths are added to the language server's schema selection pool.

ifc.analysis.astFileSizeLimitMb.markdownDescription: Maximum IFC file size in MiB for AST-backed language-server features. Larger files keep basic hover, navigation, and semantic tokens available, but skip schema diagnostics and derived-value hover.

ifc.semanticTokens.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable range-based semantic tokens provided by the IFC language server.

ifc.trace.server.markdownDescription: Trace level for the IFC language server protocol traffic.
